text: How old are you?
hint: Not scored — it sets your retirement timeline and how much risk suits your stage of life.

STUDENT.hint: Not scored — it tells us how many years your money has to grow.

RETIREE.hint: Not scored — it shapes how long your savings need to last and how much risk suits you.

text: Roughly what is your monthly take-home income?
hint: What reaches your account after tax and EPF: salary, pension plus regular withdrawals, or allowance and part-time pay. Not scored — it sizes your plan.

STUDENT.text: How much money comes to you in a typical month?
STUDENT.hint: Pocket money, allowance, stipend, scholarship, part-time or internship pay — whatever reaches you. Enter 0 if nothing comes regularly. Not scored — it sizes your plan.

RETIREE.text: Roughly how much comes in each month?
RETIREE.hint: Pension, annuity, interest, rent and any regular withdrawals from your savings, after tax. Not scored — it sizes your plan.

PROFESSIONAL.hint: Your salary as it lands in your account — after tax, EPF and other deductions — plus any regular side or freelance income. Not scored — it sizes your plan.

text: Roughly what percentage of your take-home income do you save or invest in a typical month?
hint: Count SIPs, RDs, and money you move to savings. Leave out EPF — it's already taken out before your take-home.

STUDENT.hint: Count anything you put aside — money left in your savings account counts, and so does an SIP.

text: How many months of essential expenses could you cover from money you can withdraw within a few days?
hint: Count savings accounts, liquid funds and FDs you can break. Leave out stocks, PPF, EPF and gold.

STUDENT.text: If you suddenly needed money — a broken phone, a doctor's visit, a trip home — how many months of your usual spending could you cover from your own savings, without asking anyone?
STUDENT.hint: Count savings you can get to within a few days. Money your family would step in with doesn't count here.

RETIREE.hint: Count savings accounts, liquid funds and FDs you can break early. Leave out money locked in SCSS, annuities, equity and gold.

text: Put simply: if your income stopped today, how long could you keep paying rent, food and bills from money you can get to quickly?

options.C: 3 to 6 months

PROFESSIONAL.text: Put simply: if you lost your job today, how long could you keep paying rent, EMIs, food and bills from money you can get to quickly?

text: A video caller in uniform says your Aadhaar is linked to a crime, you're under "digital arrest", and you must transfer money to clear your name. What should you do?

options.C: Share your bank OTP so they can verify your account
options.D: Stay on the call and ask a family member to send the money

text: A stranger says they sent you money by mistake and sends a UPI request asking you to return it. What should you do?

options.A: Approve it and enter your UPI PIN — it's only fair
options.B: Don't approve it: you never need your PIN to receive money — check your bank app and report the request
options.C: Share the OTP they ask for so the bank can reverse it
options.D: Approve half the amount to be safe
